name: dope.security
mood: Midnight terminal with violet beacons, frosted nav, stamped mono labels, GrandSlang hero drama, and shadowless hairline structure.

nearBlack.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, filled button backgrounds, and the default void.

iron.role: Dark borders, separators, ghost washes, and subtle panel fills.

graphite.role: Card internal text and subtle dividers.

ash.role: Nav dividers, helper text, and low-emphasis body copy.

steel.role: Muted secondary text, inactive button surfaces, and subdued borders.

almostWhite.role: Primary text, icon strokes, nav labels, and hairline borders.

signalViolet.role: The only chromatic signal: feature card glow, one primary fill, and accent strokes.

lavenderMist.role: Soft tint paired with Signal Violet for contrast-safe text and washed accents.

frostedNav.role: Sticky navigation background with backdrop blur.

pinkWash.role: Ghost pill and boarding-pass translucent panel fill.

fallbacks.mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, monospace
fallbacks.display: Tiempos Headline, Lora Italic, Georgia, serif

rules: Use Whyte Inktrap for body, nav, buttons, links, and most headings.
Use Whyte Inktrap Mono for stamped section headings and coordinate stamps.
Use GrandSlang italic only for hero and large display phrases.
Do not mix mono stamps and GrandSlang on one line.

components.name: Hero Boarding Pass
components.recipe: Split hero with atmospheric photo, GrandSlang and Whyte text, translucent 19.2px boarding-pass card, barcode, and pill CTAs.

components.name: Stamped Section Heading
components.recipe: Whyte Inktrap Mono 74px uppercase, 0.2em tracking, Soft White, no decoration.

components.name: Filled Action Button
components.recipe: Near Black fill, 1px Almost White border, 8px radius, 16px padding, Whyte 16px/400.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.recipe: Pink Wash fill, 1584px radius, 20px by 32px padding, Almost White text.

components.name: Compact Outlined Button
components.recipe: Faint white fill, 1px Almost White border, 6px radius, 9px by 15px padding.

components.name: Frosted Nav Bar
components.recipe: rgba(51,50,72,0.7) background, blur(10px), 1px Ash bottom border, uppercase tracked nav.

components.name: Comparison Card
components.recipe: 19.2px card with violet bloom or gradient background, 40px padding, route-line markers, no shadow.

components.name: Feature Row Card
components.recipe: Transparent row, 19.2px radius, no visible container, spacing-defined boundary.

components.name: Violet Bloom Card
components.recipe: Signal Violet fill or radial bloom, 19.2px radius, 40px padding, one or two per page maximum.

components.name: Coordinate Footer
components.recipe: Dark footer with plus icon, product labels, and Whyte 14px coordinate stamp.

components.name: Hairline Divider
components.recipe: 0.5px or 1px Almost White stroke at 10 to 20 percent opacity.

do: Use Signal Violet only for one feature glow, one filled action, and one accent stroke per page.
Set section headings in Whyte Inktrap Mono at 74px uppercase with 0.2em tracking.
Use 19.2px cards with translucent fills or layout-defined boundaries.
Use GrandSlang italic at 88px to 146px for the largest display moments.
Use frosted nav with blur and a hairline bottom border.
End pages with a coordinate stamp footer.
dont: Do not apply box shadows beyond the nav hairline.
Do not use Signal Violet for borders, text, or body backgrounds.
Do not mix Whyte Inktrap Mono with GrandSlang on the same line.
Do not introduce another accent color.
Do not center body copy or use multi-column text layouts.
Do not use 0px or 4px buttons; use 8px buttons or huge pill CTAs.

imagery.style: One dramatic twilight hero photo plus typography, rules, line icons, and violet bloom cards.
rules: Use a wide atmospheric hero image with purple sky and horizon glow.
Let text sit directly on the hero photo.
Use minimal line glyphs in Almost White.
Avoid product screenshots after the hero.
Keep imagery under about 15 percent of the page after the hero.

layout.structure: Full-bleed dark sections with a centered 1200px content max-width.
layout.hero: Split about 55/45 with editorial type on the left and translucent boarding-pass card on the right.
layout.navigation: Sticky frosted nav with brand left, nav center, two controls right.
layout.sectionRhythm: 120px section gaps, stamped headings, left-aligned copy, and up to four-column comparison grids.
